claim_scope: For each integer n >= 2, the numerical semigroup generated by the consecutive pentagonal numbers P(n), P(n+1), P(n+2) is symmetric exactly at n=2,3,5,40.
integrity: A written algebraic proof establishes an exhaustive infinite classification; the standard-library checker gives an independent finite Apéry-set cross-check. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No claims about general nonsymmetric Frobenius values or other polygonal families. An earlier unindexed symmetry classification may exist. OEIS already records individual Frobenius numbers, including n=40.
title: Complete symmetry classification for consecutive pentagonal triples
